title: Mi a Baj? – Asking What's Wrong

sections.title: Three short questions for any complaint
sections.content: Mi a baj? ("What's wrong?"), Mi fáj? ("What hurts?") and Hol fáj? ("Where does it hurt?") are the standard questions for checking in on someone. baj is a general word for "trouble, problem" — Mi a baj? works for any kind of problem, not only health, but it's especially common when someone looks unwell.

items.spanish: Mi a baj? Rosszul nézel ki.

sections.content: mi and hol are both question words you already know well — this lesson just points them at fáj and baj, the two anchors of any health conversation.
